title: Normalize Puzzle Plugin Crate to Consistency Contract
description: Normalize puzzle/plugin/rs/** (Puzzle2dPlayApp/Puzzle3dPlayApp/Puzzle5dPlayApp under pub mod d2/d3/d5) onto semio_framework_plugin's PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit SDK primitives, per the Consistency Contract (C1-C7) applied in Wave 2 to every other app crate. Delete the three near-duplicate hand-rolled tree_item/labels/testkit-scaffolding copies (one per d2/d3/d5), rewire onto shared SDK, rename registration regions to 🔖Manifest and tests regions to 🧪Tests, verify resource_kind and PascalCase naming. Do NOT touch puzzle/2d/rs, puzzle/3d/rs, puzzle/5d/rs domain crates. Be extra careful (smallest-span mechanical edits only) in selection/drag-and-drop code paths recently touched by human tickets PUZZLE-3D-SELECTION-AND-TOOLS-OVERHAUL and PUZZLE-3D-CATALOGUE-DRAG-AND-DROP-RESTORE (both closed).
summary: Normalized puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Puzzle2dPlayApp/Puzzle3dPlayApp/Puzzle5dPlayApp under pub mod d2/d3/d5) onto semio_framework_plugin's SDK primitives per the Consistency Contract. C1 naming and resource_kind declarations were already correct (verified, no changes). C2: renamed d2's "🔖AppFactory" region to "🔖Manifest" (d3/d5 already conformant); C3 Tests regions already conformant everywhere. Terminology: all three label resolvers now call the SDK's is_de_locale() for the locale leg instead of hand-rolling the starts_with("de") check; the rest (struct/NATIVE/REUSE consts/resolver) stays local since the apps resolve an extra "terminology" (native/reuse) axis via ViewState.terminology that the SDK's LocaleLabels/app_labels!/resolve_labels do not model (flagged for Wave 4). PanelKit: d2's tree_item_with_action was a byte-identical duplicate of the SDK's and is now deleted in favor of the import; render_document_panel rewritten onto PanelTreeBuilder::section_or_placeholder, and kind_catalog_section's hand-rolled empty-placeholder UiTreeItemNode literal replaced with tree_item(...). d3/d5 kept their own icon_id-based tree_item_with_action untouched (not expressible via the SDK's description-based primitive without dropping icon support; flagged for Wave 4), and their build_document_tree/build_kinds_tree/build_inspector_tree were deliberately left un-migrated to PanelTreeBuilder given that block plus the ticket's caution around d3's freshly-touched selection/drag-and-drop tree code. Testkit (the bulk of the work, ~66 tests across all three submodules): replaced each submodule's duplicated meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() boilerplate with semio_framework_plugin::testkit's shared primitives (matching gis-plugin/layout-plugin's established testkit:: call pattern), mechanically rewiring every call site; zero test-body/assertion/action-arg lines were touched (confirmed via diff).
